newsitem.title: UK: IPE natgas sees no trade all day for the first time.
newsitem.headline: IPE natgas sees no trade all day for the first time.

text.p: The IPE's natural gas futures contract was untraded on Monday for the first time since its launch on January 29.

There have been several occasions, including last Friday afternoon, when whole sessions have passed without trade, but this is the first day on which both morning and afternoon sessions have seen no deals.

A spokeswoman for the exchange attributed the absence of trade to the fact that it is a Monday, when trade is often thin on both the futures and physical markets, and to the fact that bids and offers were so far apart in the morning that most dealers withdrew them in the afternoon.
